lore.common: Gets stuck in the log so firmly that it takes two people to pull it out.
lore.uncommon: Splits a log in half with one swing and a very satisfying crack.
lore.rare: Splits anything it is pointed at, so the grown-ups keep it locked in the shed and point it only at logs.
lore.epic: Split so much firewood that the woodpile toppled and rolled logs all the way down the lane.
lore.legendary: Split one log so cleanly that the two halves are still standing up in the woodshed, too surprised to fall over.

names.legendary: The Bike That Went Nowhere Fast

lore.common: Gets used as a clothes horse for jumpers every other week of the year.
lore.uncommon: Has a little screen showing a beautiful mountain road that freezes on the same cow every time.
lore.rare: Spins so fast that the fan on its front blows the papers off the desk.
lore.epic: Was pedalled by the whole family on the first day of January, and was a clothes horse again by February.
lore.legendary: Was pedalled the distance round the whole world in one living room, and its rider never left the house.

lore.common: Sweeps everything into a pile and leaves one stubborn line of dust.
lore.uncommon: Sheds its bristles faster than it sweeps up the dust.
lore.rare: Catches cobwebs from the ceiling, and the spiders move house in a huff.
lore.epic: Swept the street so fast on spring cleaning day that the cat, two pigeons and a parked bike ended up in one neat pile.
lore.legendary: Swept so hard one windy day that it took off, did a lap of the garden and landed in next door's cauliflowers.

lore.common: Squirts oil everywhere except the squeaky hinge.
lore.uncommon: Drips oil on the floor so the garage smells of motors.
lore.rare: Oils things so well that the whole house goes silent, and nobody can hear anyone sneaking to the biscuit tin any more.
lore.epic: Oiled every chain in the school bike shed, and the bikes rode off so fast that the children had to run after them.
lore.legendary: Oiled the stiff hands of the town clock so well that they slid round twice, and the town had two lunchtimes.

lore.common: Has a lid that needs a screwdriver and three tries to open.
lore.uncommon: Drips a stripe down its own side that dries before you notice.
lore.rare: Looks one colour in the tin and turns out a completely different colour on the wall.
lore.epic: Was kicked over during the bedroom makeover, and the carpet became the same colour as the walls.
lore.legendary: Painted every front door on the street a different colour, and now the postman delivers by colour and nobody gets the right letters.

names.legendary: Iron Ivan of the Spare Room

lore.common: Gets left on the floor where you'll stub your toe on it.
lore.uncommon: Is used as a doorstop more often than as a weight.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who lifts it grunt as if they're lifting a car.
lore.epic: Was dropped so hard that the treadmills started by themselves, and two people ran a mile before they noticed.
lore.legendary: Was lifted so often by one grandma that she now carries the shopping, the car and occasionally the neighbour.

lore.common: Finds your thumb more often than the nail.
lore.uncommon: Bends every second nail so it has to be pulled out again.
lore.rare: Pulls out old nails with its claw so easily that nothing in the house is safe.
lore.epic: Banged in so many nails in one weekend that the house next door started leaning over to see what was going on.
lore.legendary: Built a whole treehouse in one afternoon, and the tree liked it so much that it grew a second floor.

lore.common: Has a strap so fiddly that it takes five minutes to fasten.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a stripy pattern on your hair after every ride.
lore.rare: Bounces off everything, including its rider's own front door. It took a while to get into the house.
lore.epic: Was worn by every child on the school cycle parade, and the street looked like a row of beetles.
lore.legendary: Took a tumble so its rider did not have to, then insisted on rolling home by itself. It got there first.

lore.common: Pinches every hair as it's pulled on.
lore.uncommon: Squeaks loudly every time it's pulled off.
lore.rare: Makes its wearer swim so fast that the lane rope wobbles.
lore.epic: Was worn by the whole swim club at once, and the pool looked like a box of coloured eggs.
lore.legendary: Swam so fast that it got out of the pool before its swimmer and waited on the side with a towel.

lore.common: Drives into the lake with a huge splash that soaks everyone on the bank.
lore.uncommon: Is half bus and half boat, and can never decide which.
lore.rare: Drives up waterfalls the wrong way, and the salmon have started catching lifts.
lore.epic: Drove the whole harbour tour into the sea, and every tourist screamed then laughed.
lore.legendary: Drove so far out on one tour that it reached a little island, and the island now has a bus stop.

lore.common: Needs polishing every week or it turns green.
lore.uncommon: Is screwed onto a park bench with a kind message for whoever sits there.
lore.rare: Glints in the sun so brightly that people stop to read it.
lore.epic: Was polished so brightly that it bounced the sun into the bakery and toasted every loaf in the window.
lore.legendary: Reminded one man on its bench to enjoy the view so well that he is still there, and the council has built him a little roof.

lore.common: Boings out of the pen when you take it apart, and is never seen again.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself with every other spring in the drawer.
lore.rare: Bounces so high when dropped that it lands on the bookcase.
lore.epic: Bounced out of the mattress and every spring in the bed followed it.
lore.legendary: Bounced so high off a trampoline that it landed in a passing hot-air balloon, and is now on holiday.

lore.common: Snags your jumper every time you walk past it.
lore.uncommon: Holds so many coats that it looks like a woolly monster.
lore.rare: Catches things that were never meant to be hung, like the dog's lead and the cat.
lore.epic: Fell off the wall with every coat on it, and the whole hall disappeared under jackets.
lore.legendary: Held up a coat so full of conkers that it lifted the house half an inch, and the doors now close properly for the first time.

lore.common: Ties itself in shoelaces whenever you're in a hurry.
lore.uncommon: Pulls tighter the more you try to undo it.
lore.rare: Holds so firmly that the rope snapped before it did.
lore.epic: Tied two shoelaces so well at sports day that the three-legged race became a twelve-legged race.
lore.legendary: Tied itself so firmly round a tree that nobody could undo it, so the family moved the tree instead.

lore.common: Thumps so loudly when the pestle is used that the neighbours hear.
lore.uncommon: Grinds spices into a powder so fine that it floats.
lore.rare: Grinds peppercorns so hard that the whole kitchen sneezes in chorus.
lore.epic: Thumped so hard on curry night that the plates danced off the shelf and landed in a neat stack on the table.
lore.legendary: Ground one peppercorn so fine that it seasoned every pot of soup in town for a whole year.

lore.common: Falls into the guitar's sound hole and rattles around inside.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a tiny scratch on the guitar every time, and the scratches now spell something nobody can read.
lore.rare: Strums so fast that the guitar starts playing songs it was never taught.
lore.epic: Strummed every guitar in the garage band, and the neighbours danced.
lore.legendary: Was thrown into the crowd at a big concert, bounced off forty heads and landed back in the guitarist's pocket.

lore.common: Makes curly wood shavings that end up in everyone's hair.
lore.uncommon: Shaves a sticky door just enough so it closes again.
lore.rare: Smooths anything it touches, including the cat, which now slides off every sofa in the house.
lore.epic: Filled the whole workshop with curly shavings up to the workbench.
lore.legendary: Shaved a plank so thin that you can read the newspaper through it, and the family uses it as a window.

lore.common: Splatters clay onto everyone's face when it spins too fast.
lore.uncommon: Makes every pot slightly wonky, no matter how careful the potter.
lore.rare: Spins so fast that anything put on it turns into a bowl, including the potter's sandwich.
lore.epic: Spun so fast in pottery class that every pot flew off and landed on the shelf, already in a neat row.
lore.legendary: Made every mug in the village cafe, all so wonky that the cafe now sells tea by the slosh.

lore.common: Tangles its line into a bird's nest on the first cast.
lore.uncommon: Clicks as it winds so loudly that every fish in the river hears.
lore.rare: Winds in so fast that the fish arrives before it has decided to bite.
lore.epic: Snarled its line round a whole riverbank of reeds, and the ducks sat in the tangle all day like a hammock.
lore.legendary: Hooked a fish so big that the fish reeled in the angler instead, and they now take turns.

lore.common: Rings its bell and flashes its lights at the seagulls, who are not impressed.
lore.uncommon: Has been switched off for years but still hums a little tune whenever the pier lights come on.
lore.rare: Swallows every token and gives back only noise.
lore.epic: Jingled so loudly on the pier that the seagulls thought it was the ice cream van.
lore.legendary: Was retired to a museum, and still flashes its lights so proudly that the guards wear sunglasses.

names.legendary: The Spindle That Spun a Mile

lore.common: Twists its thread into knots if it's spun too fast.
lore.uncommon: Spins on its point like a spinning top.
lore.rare: Has a sharp point that pricks every curious finger.
lore.epic: Spun so fast at the craft fair that it wound every visitor's scarf into one long woolly rope.
lore.legendary: Spun a single thread so long that it went round the whole village.

lore.common: Is always being pushed higher by someone saying higher, higher.
lore.uncommon: Pinches fingers in its chains when you hold on wrong.
lore.rare: Bumps into the person walking past at exactly the wrong moment.
lore.epic: Was swung so hard all lunchtime that its creaking drowned out the dinner bell, and nobody went in.
lore.legendary: Swings by itself every evening after the park closes, and the park keeper now gives it a push before going home.

lore.common: Blocks the whole view from the window seat.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles its flaps so much on landing that nervous passengers grip their seats.
lore.rare: Waves its flaps so politely that the plane in front always lets it land first.
lore.epic: Wobbled through turbulence so wildly that every passenger's peanuts flew in the air.
lore.legendary: Flew so smoothly over the sea that a flock of geese tucked in behind it and reached Spain without flapping.

names.legendary: Tall Tallis of the Garden Shed

lore.common: Bangs into your shins every time it's carried round a corner.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on its top step so nobody wants to stand there.
lore.rare: Reaches the roof gutter, the attic hatch and the top of the tallest bookcase in one day.
lore.epic: Was knocked over on painting day and leaned against the wrong house, so next door got their gutter painted instead.
lore.legendary: Was climbed so high by the window cleaner that he cleaned the clouds too, and the town had a very sunny week.

lore.common: Needs its cord pulled ten times before it starts.
lore.uncommon: Fills its bag with grass so fast that it needs emptying every lap.
lore.rare: Mows stripes into the lawn so neat that the neighbours get jealous.
lore.epic: Roared up every garden on Sunday morning, and nobody on the street got a lie-in.
lore.legendary: Mowed the cricket pitch so perfectly that the players asked for its autograph.

lore.common: Spreads the puddle into a bigger puddle before it soaks it up.
lore.uncommon: Gets wrung out so hard that it splashes the person wringing it.
lore.rare: Shines the floor so well that everyone slips on it.
lore.epic: Mopped up the whole kitchen when the washing machine flooded, and saved the family's best rug.
lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole paddling pool in one go, then wrung itself out over the vegetable patch.

names.legendary: The Brush That Painted a Sunset

lore.common: Drops its bristles in the wet paint every time.
lore.uncommon: Drips paint down its handle onto your hand.
lore.rare: Paints a stroke so smooth that nobody can see where it started.
lore.epic: Painted the fence so quickly that it did the gate, the shed and next door's fence before anyone could say stop.
lore.legendary: Painted a sunset so real that the birds flew towards it.

lore.common: Grabs everything by its slipperiest corner, so screws ping off across the floor.
lore.uncommon: Bends wire into any shape, including shapes nobody asked for.
lore.rare: Yanks out stubborn nails that hammers have given up on.
lore.epic: Pulled so hard on a stuck pipe that the whole sink came off the wall.
lore.legendary: Pulled a stuck ring off a finger, a key out of a drain and a splinter out of a paw in one day.

lore.common: Spits leaves into the hair of whoever is holding it.
lore.uncommon: Cuts a wobbly line along the top of every hedge.
lore.rare: Shapes hedges into animals that look surprisingly real.
lore.epic: Trimmed the hedge so low that the neighbours on the other side waved hello for the first time in years, and were not pleased.
lore.legendary: Trimmed a garden maze so cleverly that the gardener got lost in it and was found three days later by a hedgehog.

names.legendary: The Blower That Cleared the Park

lore.common: Roars so loudly on Saturday morning that the whole street wakes up.
lore.uncommon: Blows the leaves onto next door's lawn, who blows them straight back.
lore.rare: Whips the leaves into a tornado that spins round the garden.
lore.epic: Blew so hard on full power that it cleared the leaves, the gravel and next door's garden gnome off the drive.
lore.legendary: Cleared every leaf in the park in one morning, and the children had to find a new pile to jump in.

lore.common: Cracks the wall around the hole it's meant to be making.
lore.uncommon: Buzzes so loudly that every neighbour knows someone's doing DIY.
lore.rare: Makes holes in places nobody remembers wanting holes.
lore.epic: Drilled one hole so deep that it came out in the neighbour's kitchen, and the neighbour hung a picture on the other end.
lore.legendary: Built a whole kitchen by itself overnight, and the family woke up to find it had also made breakfast.

names.legendary: The Rake That Made the Biggest Pile

lore.common: Waits face-up on the grass so that stepping on it whacks you in the nose.
lore.uncommon: Piles leaves into a heap that the wind scatters immediately.
lore.rare: Scratches the lawn so hard that it pulls up all the moss.
lore.epic: Made a leaf pile so big that every child in the street jumped in at once.
lore.legendary: Raked a pile of leaves so tall that a hedgehog family moved in for the winter.

lore.common: Sings a wobbly note every time it bends, and the cat leaves the room.
lore.uncommon: Makes so much sawdust that the whole workshop looks like it snowed.
lore.rare: Cuts so fast that the plank does not notice until it is put down, then falls in half with a gasp.
lore.epic: Sawed every plank for the school play's set in one afternoon, including a whole castle.
lore.legendary: Sawed through a log as wide as a car and found a family of squirrels inside, who asked it to add a door while it was there.

lore.common: Slips out of the screw head and skids across the table.
lore.uncommon: Is always the wrong kind, flat when you need a cross.
lore.rare: Gets used to open paint tins far more than to turn screws.
lore.epic: Built a whole wardrobe at midnight with only three screws left over.
lore.legendary: Tightened one screw so hard that it came out on the other side of the world, where somebody uses it as a coat hook.

names.legendary: The Shovel That Dug the Pond

lore.common: Gets clay stuck to it so that every scoop weighs twice as much.
lore.uncommon: Has a handle just slightly too short, so every gardener walks home bent like a question mark.
lore.rare: Digs holes so fast that the dog gives up and lies down.
lore.epic: Dug the vegetable patch so deep that it found an old bath, a rusty bike and next door's lost tortoise.
lore.legendary: Dug a whole pond in one weekend, and the frogs moved in by Monday.

lore.common: Snaps back so fast that it catches your fingertip.
lore.uncommon: Bends in the middle every time you try to measure something high.
lore.rare: Measures everything twice and gives two different answers.
lore.epic: Measured a sofa that still didn't fit through the door, and the whole family spent the evening pushing.
lore.legendary: Measured the tallest tree in the park by climbing it, one inch at a time.

lore.common: Rattles so loudly in the car boot that the driver keeps pulling over to check for a flat tyre.
lore.uncommon: Has every tool except the one you need right now.
lore.rare: Is so heavy that it needs two people and a lot of groaning.
lore.epic: Tipped over in the garage, and every screw, nail and nut rolled under the car.
lore.legendary: Fixed so many things in the village that the things started breaking on purpose, just to get a visit.

lore.common: Twists round so the medal hangs on the back of your neck.
lore.uncommon: Swings its medal so that it clinks against your buttons.
lore.rare: Makes its wearer stand a little taller all day.
lore.epic: Got its ribbons tangled at the fun run, so every finisher crossed the line tied together like a giant necklace.
lore.legendary: Held a medal that its owner wore to bed for a whole week.

lore.common: Collects dust on the top shelf after the first week of being admired.
lore.uncommon: Has a handle that snaps off if you lift it too excitedly.
lore.rare: Shines so brightly in the cabinet that visitors forget to look at anything else.
lore.epic: Was knocked over in the cabinet, and every trophy fell over like dominoes.
lore.legendary: Was won so often by one team that it now walks to their clubhouse by itself every spring.

lore.common: Is blown by every child who finds it, right next to someone's ear.
lore.uncommon: Has a little pea inside that rattles when it's shaken.
lore.rare: Calls every child back from the far end of the beach in one blast.
lore.epic: Was blown at the zoo, and every flamingo swapped to its other leg at once, then glared.
lore.legendary: Blew a note so high that only dogs could hear it, and every dog in the county turned up for a walk.

lore.common: Blasts at exactly the moment you were about to score.
lore.uncommon: Calls offside when nobody can see why.
lore.rare: Blows itself, so every match ends exactly when the home team is winning.
lore.epic: Blew full time so loudly that the pigeons on the stadium roof took off and spelled FULL TIME in the sky.
lore.legendary: Blew full time so firmly that the rain stopped too, and the grass lay down for a well-earned rest.

lore.common: Tips over just as you turn the corner.
lore.uncommon: Has a wheel that squeaks with every turn.
lore.rare: Gives rides to every child in the family, even when it's full of compost.
lore.epic: Raced round the garden so fast that the compost jumped out and planted itself in the flowerbed.
lore.legendary: Carried every stone for a whole garden wall, then refused to carry anything else because nothing was as important.

lore.common: Slips off the nut and skins your knuckles.
lore.uncommon: Is always one size too big or too small.
lore.rare: Grips nuts from across the room, so every tap in the house tightens itself when it walks in.
lore.epic: Fixed a burst pipe at midnight while the whole family held towels.
lore.legendary: Tightened a tap so hard that the river at the bottom of the garden stopped for an afternoon. The ducks walked across.

lore.common: Flings sand into everyone's sandwiches.
lore.uncommon: Digs moats round every sandcastle so the sea fills them up.
lore.rare: Digs a hole so deep in one go that it fills with sea and grows a tiny tide of its own.
lore.epic: Built a whole sandcastle town with towers, walls and a bridge before the tide came in.
lore.legendary: Dug a hole on the beach so deep that a crab moved in and stayed for the summer.

lore.common: Loses its nut the moment it's dropped.
lore.uncommon: Rusts so tightly in place that it will never come out.
lore.rare: Bolts itself onto anything nearby, so the bench is now bolted to the shed and the shed to the tree.
lore.epic: Rolled off the workbench, and the whole workshop spent an hour looking for it.
lore.legendary: Held the old pier together through a storm so wild that the pier bent into a smile and stayed that way.

lore.common: Wobbles for ages before it decides whether to fall.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked down by every bowler, then stands up again to be knocked down.
lore.rare: Falls in a perfect strike with all its friends.
lore.epic: Fell over so dramatically that the whole bowling alley stood up and clapped, and it took a bow by falling over again.
lore.legendary: Survived a whole bowling season standing up, and the bowlers gave it a nickname.

lore.common: Clicks its blade out and in so often that everyone says put that away.
lore.uncommon: Opens every box on moving day, as long as a grown-up is holding it.
lore.rare: Slits tape so quietly that the parcel does not notice it has been opened, and keeps pretending to be sealed.
lore.epic: Unpacked every box in the new house in one day, with a very careful grown-up.
lore.legendary: Opened a box so gently that the cat asleep inside never woke up, and the whole house move happened around it.

lore.common: Is always one hook too short, so everyone stretches it with gritted teeth and their eyes shut.
lore.uncommon: Hugs the bags onto the roof rack.
lore.rare: Stretches so far that it seems to have no end.
lore.epic: Pinged off the roof rack on the motorway, and the suitcases slid off one by one.
lore.legendary: Held the holiday luggage on so tightly that, when the family arrived, the roof came off with it.

lore.common: Comes out of the drawer with three other cables, a hair clip and a key attached.
lore.uncommon: Is exactly ten centimetres too short to reach from the socket to the bed.
lore.rare: Plugs itself into anything, so the toaster is charging the cat flap and the lamp is charging grandad's slippers.
lore.epic: Was pulled out of the drawer and just kept coming, until its far end turned out to be plugged into the house next door.
lore.legendary: Fits every gadget in the house, which no cable has ever done before.

lore.common: Swings in the wind so that every passenger grips the rail.
lore.uncommon: Has the best view on the mountain, and everyone squashes to the window.
lore.rare: Stops exactly halfway up whenever the view is best, which is usually when someone needs the toilet.
lore.epic: Carried so many skiers up on the first snowy day that the mountain tipped slightly, and the hut at the top now has a sloping floor.
lore.legendary: Carried a cow up the mountain by mistake, and the cow liked the view so much that it now has a season ticket.

lore.common: Clanks against the bike frame on every bump in the road.
lore.uncommon: Slips off the bike's gears at the bottom of every hill.
lore.rare: Locks itself round anything left still for a minute, so the picnic table is now chained to the bike.
lore.epic: Rattled so loudly down a bumpy farm lane that every dog came out to bark along, and the cows joined the chorus.
lore.legendary: Held a bike to a lamp post so well that, when the lamp post was moved for roadworks, the bike went with it.

lore.common: Leaves splinters in the wood it carves.
lore.uncommon: Gets hit by its mallet so often that it has started flinching whenever anyone picks one up.
lore.rare: Carves shapes into wood that look like they've grown there.
lore.epic: Carved a whole chess set in one weekend, and the knights keep jumping off the board.
lore.legendary: Carved the park gate with every animal in the forest, and now the real squirrels queue up to be carved too.

lore.common: Clamps your finger as well as the wood.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles loose just as the glue is setting.
lore.rare: Clamps on to anything it is pointed at, so the curtain, a sock and a loaf of bread are all stuck to the bench.
lore.epic: Was used by the whole woodwork class at once, and by home time every bench was clamped into one long table.
lore.legendary: Held a violin while its glue set, and now the violin plays perfectly, but only when someone squeezes it.

lore.common: Crumbles the cork into the bottle every time.
lore.uncommon: Raises its arms like a little person cheering as it twists.
lore.rare: Wrestles with every stubborn cork until the bottle gives up.
lore.epic: Opened every fizzy grape juice at the party, and the corks flew across the room.
lore.legendary: Twisted into one cork so stubborn that it pulled out the bottle, the tablecloth and the table in one go.

lore.common: Misses the hoop by a hair every single time.
lore.uncommon: Whacks the lawn instead of the ball.
lore.rare: Sends the opponent's ball flying into the flowerbed.
lore.epic: Started a croquet game at the garden party that turned into a battle over the rose bush.
lore.legendary: Hit the ball so hard through the first hoop that it went through every hoop in the garden and three in the next one.

lore.common: Bangs into your shins when you carry it.
lore.uncommon: Opens every wooden crate with a big creak.
lore.rare: Prises open things that have been stuck for years.
lore.epic: Opened every crate at the museum delivery, and one dinosaur bone walked off to look for its friends.
lore.legendary: Prised open an old trunk in the attic that held grandma's lost roller skates, and grandma has not been seen indoors since.

lore.common: Gurgles loudly every time it rains.
lore.uncommon: Gets clogged with leaves so the gutter overflows.
lore.rare: Gushes water out of its bottom so fast that it splashes the windows.
lore.epic: Gushed so hard in the storm that the garden became a pond.
lore.legendary: Gushed so hard in one storm that it shot a trout onto the lawn, and the cat has been waiting by it ever since.

lore.common: Has two handles that swing back and forth, so whoever walks past gets elbowed.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles so much that its user holds on with both hands.
lore.rare: Glides so smoothly that its user forgets they're exercising.
lore.epic: Glided so smoothly at the gym that its rider forgot to get off and stayed through the cleaner, the night shift and breakfast.
lore.legendary: Glided so smoothly that it slid across the gym, out of the door and halfway to the shops with its rider still striding.

names.legendary: Sir Slitsworth of the Writing Desk

lore.common: Opens every letter in the pile except the one marked URGENT, which it always saves for later.
lore.uncommon: Sits on the desk looking like a tiny knight's weapon.
lore.rare: Opens envelopes so neatly that they could be closed again.
lore.epic: Opened every letter that arrived on the first day of the holidays, and the desk disappeared under paper.
lore.legendary: Opened a letter so neatly that the letter sealed itself again and posted itself back, unopened.

lore.common: Comes out of the box as one giant tangle.
lore.uncommon: Stops working because one tiny bulb has gone out.
lore.rare: Twinkles so prettily that everyone stops to look.
lore.epic: Was strung through every tree at the garden party, and the garden glowed till midnight.
lore.legendary: Twinkled so convincingly that a swarm of fireflies tried to join the string, and one bulb has buzzed ever since.

lore.common: Makes a scraping screech that sets everyone's teeth on edge.
lore.uncommon: Gets borrowed for nails, even though it's meant for metal.
lore.rare: Files so smoothly that it took the corners off a box, and now the box rolls.
lore.epic: Filed the rough edges off every chair in the workshop, and now nobody can stop sliding off them.
lore.legendary: Filed a rocky mountain path so smooth that the goats now use it as a slide.

lore.common: Kinks itself so the water stops just when you need it.
lore.uncommon: Sprays you in the face when you look down the end to see what's wrong.
lore.rare: Lies on the lawn looking like a snake, and the cat avoids it.
lore.epic: Sprayed so wildly when the tap went on that it washed the car, the windows and a very surprised postman.
lore.legendary: Stretched all the way to the park in a drought, and the ducks sent it a thank-you feather.

lore.common: Takes a chunk of grass out of the course with every swing.
lore.uncommon: Swings so hard and misses the ball completely.
lore.rare: Hits the ball so far that nobody can see where it went.
lore.epic: Sent a ball into the pond, and every golfer spent the afternoon fishing for it.
lore.legendary: Hit a ball so hard that it went right round the world and dropped into the hole from behind, a week late.

lore.common: Disappears into the grass after every shot.
lore.uncommon: Holds the ball up like a tiny pedestal.
lore.rare: Launches the ball so high that it seems to touch the clouds.
lore.epic: Was pushed so deep into the ground that it grew roots, and the first hole now has a very small tree.
lore.legendary: Launched a ball so high that it came down a week later in the hole, and the golfer counted it.

lore.common: Fills with leaves every autumn until the rain spills over.
lore.uncommon: Drips onto the front doorstep so everyone gets a cold splash.
lore.rare: Becomes a bathtub for every bird in the garden.
lore.epic: Overflowed in a storm and sent a waterfall down the front of the house.
lore.legendary: Caught so much rain in one storm that it became the highest pond in town, with its own duck.

lore.common: Loses its teeth one by one, so every cut ends with a toothless squeak.
lore.uncommon: Bends so much that every cut wobbles.
lore.rare: Cuts through metal pipes as if they were cheese.
lore.epic: Cut the bike-shed lock so fast that every bike inside rolled out and went for a ride on its own.
lore.legendary: Cut through a garden gate lock stuck for ten years, and the gate swung open and ran off down the lane.

names.legendary: The Reel That Wound a Mile

lore.common: Is never fully wound, so the hose snakes across the patio all summer.
lore.uncommon: Has a crank handle so stiff that nobody bothers turning it.
lore.rare: Winds itself up while someone is still holding the end, and drags them across the patio.
lore.epic: Unravelled all by itself down the sloping garden and wrapped the hose round every tree.
lore.legendary: Wound up a hose so long that it reached from the house to the bottom of the allotment.

lore.common: Flicks the ball up off the grass so fast that nobody sees it happen.
lore.uncommon: Is made of ash wood and smells of the field after every match.
lore.rare: Balances the ball on its flat end while its player runs the length of the pitch.
lore.epic: Clashed with every stick in the county final, and the clacking echoed round the valley.
lore.legendary: Scored a point from so far out that the ball landed in the next county, and that county still counts it.

lore.common: Clinks against every rock on the path up the mountain.
lore.uncommon: Dangles from its wrist strap and bonks its owner on the knee.
lore.rare: Bites into ice so firmly that its climber can hang from it.
lore.epic: Struck a frozen waterfall so hard that the whole waterfall unfroze at once and soaked the climbing team.
lore.legendary: Hooked a passing cloud on a mountain top and pulled it down, and the climbers had a snowball fight inside it.

names.legendary: The Throw That Left the Stadium

lore.common: Wobbles in the air and lands flat with a sad slap.
lore.uncommon: Is carried to the throwing line so carefully that everyone else steps well back.
lore.rare: Flies so far that the officials have to jog to measure it.
lore.epic: Flew so far at sports day that it landed in the egg-and-spoon race, and won it.
lore.legendary: Flew so far that it cleared the stadium wall and landed in a farmer's field.

names.legendary: The Rope That Skipped a Thousand

lore.common: Tangles round your ankles on the first jump.
lore.uncommon: Is turned by two friends while a third jumps in the middle.
lore.rare: Skips in time with every playground rhyme ever invented.
lore.epic: Was turned so fast in the playground that a passing pigeon caught the rhythm and skipped along all lunchtime.
lore.legendary: Was skipped a thousand times in a row by one girl, who set a school record.

lore.common: Thuds so loudly with every kick that the class jumps.
lore.uncommon: Is held by the coach, who always seems to be just out of reach.
lore.rare: Catches kicks so cleanly that every student feels like a champion.
lore.epic: Took so many kicks at the grading that its stuffing flew out, and the hall looked like a snow globe.
lore.legendary: Took one kick so perfectly that it flew across the hall into the lost property box, where it is still sulking.

lore.common: Cradles the ball by wiggling back and forth, which looks very silly.
lore.uncommon: Drops the ball out of its net just as its player gets to the goal.
lore.rare: Flings the ball so fast that the goalkeeper only sees a blur.
lore.epic: Raced down the field with a whole team, and the ball never touched the ground.
lore.legendary: Caught a ball thrown from the far end of the field, then a frisbee, then a passing seagull's lunch.

lore.common: Changes colour so often that nobody can decide on one.
lore.uncommon: Peels off the wall at one end and droops.
lore.rare: Glows a colour that matches whatever mood its owner is in.
lore.epic: Turned the whole bedroom into a disco at the sleepover.
lore.legendary: Glowed so brightly purple that a passing aeroplane flashed back, and the two now chat every evening.

lore.common: Bends sideways the moment it's hammered.
lore.uncommon: Hides on the stairs waiting for a bare foot.
lore.rare: Holds up a heavy picture that should need two nails.
lore.epic: Held up every picture in the new house so straight that the house itself looked crooked by comparison.
lore.legendary: Held up a painting so heavy that the wall gave up first, and the nail and the painting still hang there on their own.

lore.common: Rolls off the workbench and under the cupboard.
lore.uncommon: Strips its thread so it spins forever.
lore.rare: Grips so tightly that the spanner gives up.
lore.epic: Got stuck on the wrong bolt and turned so stubbornly that the whole workbench turned round instead.
lore.legendary: Held a wheel on so firmly that the bike fell apart around it, and the wheel rolled all the way home alone.

lore.common: Splatters tiny dots of paint everywhere including your glasses.
lore.uncommon: Leaves streaks on the wall that only show when the paint dries.
lore.rare: Glides over a whole wall in five strokes.
lore.epic: Painted the whole bedroom in one afternoon, including the ceiling and the cat.
lore.legendary: Painted the school hall in one night, and the children came back to find even the piano was sky blue.

lore.common: Has a thumb hole that's always slightly too small.
lore.uncommon: Mixes colours so well that every new one is a surprise.
lore.rare: Turns every colour into muddy brown if it's not careful.
lore.epic: Was shared by the whole art class, and every painting came out the same shade of purple.
lore.legendary: Mixed a colour so new that the rainbow came down to look at it and took it home.

lore.common: Nicks your knuckle along with the potato skin.
lore.uncommon: Peels an apple in one long spiral that everyone tries to keep in one piece.
lore.rare: Peels anything it touches, so the potato, the apple and the label on the jam jar all came out bare.
lore.epic: Peeled so many potatoes for Sunday lunch that the peelings made a hill in the garden, and the hens climbed it for the view.
lore.legendary: Peeled the wallpaper off a whole house by mistake, and found a secret door behind it.

names.legendary: The Pick That Found the Crystal

lore.common: Strikes sparks off every rock it hits.
lore.uncommon: Breaks rocks into pebbles with one swing.
lore.rare: Digs tunnels so fast that the miners have to run to keep up.
lore.epic: Struck one rock so hard that the whole hillside rang like a bell, and the sheep on top all stood up at once.
lore.legendary: Struck a rock that split open to show a cave full of shining crystals.

names.legendary: The Mallet That Scored at Full Gallop

lore.common: Is so long that you need to be on a horse to use it.
lore.uncommon: Has a handle that bends in the middle like a willow.
lore.rare: Swings at full gallop and hits the ball every time.
lore.epic: Galloped down the field with the whole team, and the grass flew everywhere.
lore.legendary: Scored the winning goal at full gallop, and the horse got the medal.

names.legendary: The Washer That Revealed the Path

lore.common: Soaks whoever is standing nearby when it starts.
lore.uncommon: Draws clean stripes on the patio before the whole thing is done.
lore.rare: Blasts so hard that it washed the paint off the fence along with the moss, and the fence is now grey and furious.
lore.epic: Cleaned every path on the street, and the neighbours discovered their paths were red.
lore.legendary: Revealed a mosaic under the moss on an old patio that nobody knew was there.

lore.common: Swings back and bumps its puncher every time.
lore.uncommon: Rattles its chain so loudly that the whole gym hears.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who punches it feel much calmer afterwards.
lore.epic: Was punched so hard that it swung up and rang the bell for the next round all by itself.
lore.legendary: Was punched so often that it learned to dodge, and nobody in the gym has landed a punch since March.

lore.common: Gives rope burn to anyone who holds it too tightly.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself into knots inside the shed.
lore.rare: Pulls so hard in a tug of war that the other team ends up in the mud.
lore.epic: Pulled a stuck tractor out of the mud, and the tractor was so grateful that it followed the rope home.
lore.legendary: Swung a whole class across the school pond one by one, and only the teacher fell in.

lore.common: Slides its seat back so fast that its user nearly falls off.
lore.uncommon: Whooshes with every pull like a fan.
lore.rare: Makes its rower dream they're on a river.
lore.epic: Whooshed so hard at the gym that every towel in the room blew into one pile, with the instructor underneath.
lore.legendary: Rowed so hard one morning that the garage slid down the drive into the pond, and finally got to float.

names.legendary: The Screw That Was Never Left Over

lore.common: Wobbles in its hole so the shelf leans.
lore.uncommon: Strips its head so no screwdriver can turn it.
lore.rare: Turns itself in a little deeper every night, so the picture creeps up the wall a centimetre a week.
lore.epic: Was the one screw missing from the flatpack, and the whole family searched the carpet.
lore.legendary: Was the only screw ever not left over after building a wardrobe.

lore.common: Is home to every spider in the garden.
lore.uncommon: Has a door that sticks so hard you have to kick it.
lore.rare: Locks itself whenever someone needs the lawnmower, and opens only for the cat.
lore.epic: Opened its door, and every tool, bike and paddling pool fell out at once.
lore.legendary: Held so much junk that the family found their old car in it, with the picnic still in the boot.

lore.common: Flicks its owner in the face on the first try.
lore.uncommon: Has a handle that comes off mid-skip.
lore.rare: Skips so fast that it goes under the feet twice in one jump.
lore.epic: Was skipped so hard at the skipathon that the playground got a groove, and every puddle there is now rope-shaped.
lore.legendary: Skipped so fast that it tied itself into a bow round its owner, who arrived at the party already wrapped.

lore.common: Makes the whole garden shake when it's dropped.
lore.uncommon: Is so heavy that it takes two hands to lift.
lore.rare: Thumps the ground so hard that every worm in the garden comes up to see who is there.
lore.epic: Knocked down the old garden wall in one afternoon, and the neighbours came to watch.
lore.legendary: Hit the ground so hard that a mole popped up three gardens away, holding its ears.

lore.common: Makes everyone groan with every heavy scoop.
lore.uncommon: Flings snow onto the bit of path you just cleared.
lore.rare: Throws snow so far that it builds a snowman in next door's garden every time.
lore.epic: Raced every shovel on the street after the big snowfall, and the street was clear by lunch.
lore.legendary: Cleared the village lane so fast that the snowplough found nothing to do and went home in a sulk.

names.legendary: The Lights That Lit the Wedding

lore.common: Hangs perfectly straight for an hour, then droops in the middle like a sleepy smile.
lore.uncommon: Has one bulb that blinks out of time with the others, like a dancer who missed the start.
lore.rare: Makes every tree in the garden twinkle.
lore.epic: Was strung across the street for the summer fair, and the moths held their own fair underneath.
lore.legendary: Lit up a wedding so beautifully that the couple hung them in their garden forever.

lore.common: Slips its belt so its runner stumbles.
lore.uncommon: Has a red stop key that everyone forgets about.
lore.rare: Runs so fast that its runner holds on for dear life.
lore.epic: Was set so fast at rush hour that its runner shot off the back into the yoga mats, and the class made it a new pose.
lore.legendary: Ran so fast once that the belt went backwards in time, and everyone went home before they had arrived.

lore.common: Plants bulbs upside down when nobody is looking.
lore.uncommon: Has a muddy handle no matter how many times it's washed.
lore.rare: Digs out weeds so cleanly that not a root is left.
lore.epic: Dug so many holes on planting day that the squirrels took it for a buffet and buried their nuts in every one.
lore.legendary: Planted a thousand bulbs in one autumn, all upside down, and in spring the tulips came up in Australia.

lore.common: Is always plugged in upside down on the first try.
lore.uncommon: Has a plug at one end that fits nothing in the house, and a plug at the other that fits everything.
lore.rare: Charges so slowly that the battery goes down while plugged in.
lore.epic: Was pulled out by a passing dog, and three laptops, two phones and a lamp all went flying.
lore.legendary: Was plugged in upside down so confidently that the socket turned itself round to fit.

lore.common: Gets buried under everything in the toolbox, so the grown-ups tip the whole box out to find it.
lore.uncommon: Clicks its blade back in so firmly that grown-ups nod at it approvingly.
lore.rare: Cuts through rope so neatly that the ends don't fray.
lore.epic: Opened every box and cut every rope on the camping trip, in careful grown-up hands.
lore.legendary: Cut the ribbon at the new library so neatly that the ribbon tied itself back up and asked to do it again.

lore.common: Grips so tightly that nothing can wriggle out.
lore.uncommon: Pinches your fingertips when its handle is cranked too quickly.
lore.rare: Holds wood so steady that every saw cut is straight.
lore.epic: Held every project in woodwork class at once, and when the bell rang it refused to let anyone take theirs home.
lore.legendary: Held a plank so firmly through a gale that the workshop blew away and the plank stayed exactly where it was.

lore.common: Gets stuck on your finger like a ring, and everyone asks when the wedding is.
lore.uncommon: Is a tiny ring that everyone thinks is a coin.
lore.rare: Stops drips so well that the tap never leaks again.
lore.epic: Fell down the plughole and rattled through the pipes so loudly that the whole street called a plumber.
lore.legendary: Fitted so snugly into the town fountain that the fountain stopped, and the pigeons had to queue for baths elsewhere.

lore.common: Gets unravelled across the whole house by the kitten.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself into a ball that nobody can untangle.
lore.rare: Becomes a scarf, a hat and a pair of mittens all at once.
lore.epic: Unravelled so far that one end was found at the school gates, and the children followed it home like a treasure hunt.
lore.legendary: Knitted itself into a scarf while nobody was looking, and the scarf has gone off on its own adventures.
